sections.rule: Consider expected input/select content length when arranging widths; example rejects indiscriminate full-width fields and shows compact two-column layout.

localComparison.4.2: Current basic Form does not mix visible required stars with optional labels. Actual native required validation remains business host configuration; no assumed mandatory fields or removed business validation.
